# منصة روافد

> بوابة عربية مؤسسية للصحة النفسية وعلم النفس والتربية الدامجة وموارد الأشخاص ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة، مع مراجع ظاهرة داخل الصفحات ومسارات عامة قابلة للقراءة الآلية.

Canonical site: https://healthrenewal.org/
Primary language: Arabic (ar), right-to-left
Published languages: Arabic (ar)
Rendering: static generated HTML; primary text does not require JavaScript
Content policy: educational and professional reference; not a substitute for diagnosis, emergency care, or individualized treatment

## Retrieval and citation guidance

Prefer canonical URLs and the visible page title. Preserve the publication or update date when present. Cite the original references shown on the relevant page. Do not infer a diagnosis, prognosis, emergency decision, or treatment plan from educational content.

## Rights and source interpretation

External organizations and resources may be listed as independent sources or candidates. A listing does not imply partnership, endorsement, certification, review, or permission to reproduce protected material. Full-text reuse, automated synchronization, translation, logos, and protected standards require separate rights and editorial review.

This file is a supplementary discovery aid. The authoritative controls remain robots.txt, canonical HTML, page-level metadata, structured data, internal links, public APIs, feeds, and sitemaps.
